title: Efficacy and Tolerability of Xalatan in Patients
brief_summary: Efficacy data was not collected or analyzed. This study did assess safety and tolerability of Xalatan.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with ocular hypertension at least 22mg Hg
* Patient must be over 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* None listed in the protocol
study_population: adults with glauocma or ocular hypertension
